paragraphs: He is mentioned in Keritot 20a: “Ami bar Avin and Rav Chananya bar Avin both say,” etc. Some read there Abaye bar Avin. In Shabbat 20b: Ami bar Avin.[^1]

notes.text: The named Keritot 20a paragraph has Ami bar Avin and Rav Chananya bar Avin saying together, with their statement continuing in the first complete paragraph of 20b. Hyman’s reported Abaye reading was not collated in an apparatus, and his Shabbat 20b Ami citation was not established in the bounded surrounding-page routing. This is not an absence claim or an automatic Ami/Abaye identity equation.
